_comment: Golden baseline for the Kokoro fixture (ops-11; content fields added by ops-45 / #1911; ASR-stack fields added by #2004). Re-bless after editing fixture.json or an intentional Kokoro weights upgrade: `npm run test:golden-audio -- --bless` on a box with the weights, then commit. `metadata` records the weights SHA + kokoro-onnx version so a model bump is legible (a sample-count mismatch then explains 'you upgraded the model') -- and, as of #2004, `faster_whisper_version`/`ctranslate2_version` the same way for the ASR side that produces `transcript` below (a stack bump on THAT side is what actually moves a transcript on the tolerance-0 content-drift check; a mismatch explains 'you upgraded Whisper', not 'the audio changed'). `test_golden_regression.py`'s `_make_whisper()` also now pins `ASR_COMPUTE_TYPE` outright (alongside `ASR_MODEL`/`ASR_DEVICE`), so a stray ambient value can't silently apply to a golden run either. Each entry is sample-count/duration (asserted within `tolerance`) plus, since #1911, `transcript` (the recorded Whisper output -- the content-drift reference, asserted at tolerance 0) and `text_edits` (that transcript's edit distance from fixture.json's `text`, used as the re-bless cap: a later bless may not exceed `text_edits + 1`). A bless that would silently overwrite a DIFFERING `transcript` is refused unless GOLDEN_REBLESS_CONTENT=1 is also set -- see compare.bless_guard.
